Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Cygnus Health is moving toward a pilot in November and our security team needs to lock down identity and provisioning before we can start. High level asks:

- SSO/SAML integration (IdP metadata, attribute mapping, encryption preferences)

Priya / team —

Quick tech notes I prepared ahead of the kickoff so we can be precise during the call:

SAML/SSO
- We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Prefer SP-initiated for pilot.
- Required attributes: email (urn:oid:1.2.840.113549.1.9.1), givenName, familyName, and groups (optional).
- Signature algorithm: RSA-SHA256. Encryption optional; we can accept encrypted assertions if their IdP supports it.
- Attached: sso-saml-metadata.xml (example) — they should replace entityID and ACS URLs.

SCIM
- SCIM v2 standard. We will sync Users and Groups. For groups we map 'members' -> member type.
- We recommend mapping externalId -> employee_id for authoritative matching.
- Rate limits: plan for 60 reqs/min peak during initial sync (we can bump for import window).
- Attached: scim_mapping_template.csv with example attribute-to-field mapping.

IP allowlist & networking
- Expected outbound addresses from Redwood for callbacks: see ip-allowlist-ranges.txt. We recommend opening the ranges temporarily for initial tests and then restricting to observed /32s afterwards.

Service accounts & org policies
- Service account naming: cygnus-redwood-<env>-svc (see guidelines doc).
- Minimum privileges: separate admin from onboarding svc; onboarding service account only needs: User.Create, Group.Assign, SCIM.Write.
- Audit: all provisioning calls are recorded in request logs for 365 days (we can extend retention as an add-on).

I'll be on the kickoff. Laura, can you confirm MAP owner and timeline? Neha, please flag any additional compliance artifacts we should prep for HIPAA attestation.

Thanks,
Ben
